name: How long does picture rail installation usually take for a standard room?

mainEntity.name: How long does picture rail installation usually take for a standard room?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of picture rail installation for a standard room typically ranges from one to three days. This timeline can depend on factors like the size of the room, the condition of your walls, the type of material being installed, and the chosen finish. For instance, if the walls require significant preparation or if a custom paint or stain finish is applied on-site, it might take longer. Maine Results Inc. will provide a clear project timeline during your initial consultation, allowing you to plan accordingly and minimize inconvenience.
acceptedAnswer.description: For a standard room, picture rail installation usually takes 1-3 days, depending on room size, wall condition, material, and finishing requirements.
